title: A practice still being learnt: don't force exact types; new repos and packages are welcome if they help understand (2026-11-07)

sections.name: narrative

sections.content: We are talking about a practice that is still being learnt. We don't need to force exact types. We are also welcome to create new repos and try new packages is that help understand

sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-07, saying yes to filing the boundary model as a suggested decision now (one thing, a container whose identity record carries parent, purpose, origin and division; cluster, domain and boundary as names on it) with recalibration as its own exercise; recorded verbatim.
